prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response:
**Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:**

I stand before you today as a red-blooded American who hauls his own damn groceries in a vehicle that is *legally registered in my name*. 

These vicious rumors that my F-150 is some kind of... *Hertzmobile*... are the kind of filthy, un-American slander that has no place in these hearings. My truck has 187,000 miles, a dent in the tailgate from when I backed into my own mailbox in 2019, and a NRA sticker that’s been baking in the sun so long it’s half-peeled off. That is not the biography of a rental, gentlemen.

I have never, *ever* had to show a credit card and driver’s license at a counter to operate my truck. I have never found a mysterious previous renter’s beef jerky wrapper under the seat. The only thing I’ve ever found in my truck is my own poor life choices and approximately $14 in loose change.

If this Committee wishes to impound my vehicle and subject it to polygraph, fingerprint dusting, and a full cavity search for Enterprise ink stamps, I welcome it. But I will remind you that when you’re done, that truck is going to need its oil changed and the tire pressure checked, because that’s what a *man* does with his own truck.

I yield the remainder of my time and request that the record show I said “Roll Tide.”
